name: Transfer Reference 14
definition: Reference of a transfer and of a transfer cancellation.

TransferReference.name: Transfer Reference
TransferReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the portfolio transfer instruction, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the portfolio transfer. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the transfer as assigned by the underlying client.

CounterpartyReference.name: Counterparty Reference
CounterpartyReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the portfolio transfer allocated by the counterparty.

TransferConfirmationReference.name: Transfer Confirmation Reference
TransferConfirmationReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the portfolio transfer execution, as assigned by the confirming party.

CancellationReference.name: Cancellation Reference
CancellationReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the portfolio transfer cancellation, as assigned by the instructing party.
